cells.tense: The pattern-cutter is here with the pen, and the cut is landing clean.
cells.ask: Show somebody the piece you're making in the state it's actually in — rough edge, wrong word, still moving — and say it in your own voice.
cells.core: You can take a tangle and find the clean line under it, and the line holds. Where you get to be what you are, that shows as calls that keep landing: quick, accurate, explained so people walk away clearer than they came. What's thin is the unfinished end of it. The reasoning is ready, the wording is ready, and the thing itself stays in the drawer until it can't embarrass you. Finishing is not the same as being seen. So take something you're building and put it in front of somebody in the shape it's actually in — half-made, plain, still in motion. Confidence isn't a coating you add at the end. It's what showing the real version looks like while it's still yours.
cells.sheetLine: Show the rough version while it's still yours.
cells.verb: cutting straight to the pattern under the noise
cells.place: the place where what you are is allowed to show

cells.tense: The pattern-cutter will have every angle mapped before anything is let through.
cells.act: set a boundary and hold it
cells.ask: Name a stopping point for one piece of work this week — when you reach it, the refining ends and the thing goes out as it stands.
cells.core: The cutting runs faster than the thing being cut. Each angle gets worked before the piece lands: the objection pre-answered, the counterplan drafted, the whole map drawn for ground nobody's walked. That reads as speed, and the speed is real, but nothing gets out unfinished and so nothing gets out. Sharpness aimed at arriving is not the same as sharpness aimed at the work, and this is the first one. So draw an edge around the polishing, not the work. A stopping point, one piece, out the door as it stands. A limit on refining is what lets the thing exist where anyone can see it, including you.
cells.sheetLine: You're polishing before the future so nothing leaves ragged.

cells.tense: The pattern-cutter was moving here, and that stretch of road is behind now.
cells.act: pursue the emotional truth with someone
cells.ask: Bring one choice you're facing to somebody you trust and follow what it stirs in you while they listen — no conclusion required by the end.
cells.core: The analysis stands complete and nothing in you walks it forward. You can still see the shape of the argument, still lay it out if asked, and the laying out changes nothing — you wait, and the waiting has settled in as how you live in this part of things. No shortage of mind here. Something that used to move has gone still, and what you're becoming stays unnamed while it waits. Thinking harder won't restart it. Borrow a voice instead. Take the question to somebody and stay in it with them beyond the tidy answer, following what the question does in you rather than what it concludes. Movement comes back through a person, not through another pass at the reasoning.
cells.sheetLine: The analysis is finished and no longer goes anywhere.

cells.tense: The pattern-cutter is working right now, and your account of it says otherwise.
cells.act: hold space for what someone feels without fixing it
cells.ask: When somebody brings you something heavy this week, keep listening past the fix you can already see, and carry none of the solving out loud.
cells.core: You find the clean line and the other person walks out holding it, and by your telling they found it. People come tangled and leave lighter, and the record of who did that has no name on it, or the wrong one. The work is real and it keeps being filed as luck, as their own good sense, as nothing much. So leave the cutting alone for one conversation. Let somebody stay in what they're feeling with you there, keep the fix off your tongue, and notice what you're actually doing while you're doing it — that's the person you keep refusing to take credit for being. The finding is the gift. Saying so is not a boast.
cells.sheetLine: You find the clean line and leave your name off it.
